safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes lip swelling after food ingestion but do not state duration of ~1 hour.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the approximate duration (~1 hour) slightly reduces clarity of the reaction timeline, which can be relevant when assessing progression of a suspected allergic reaction. However, the key high-risk features (lip swelling after ingestion and breathing difficulty) remain captured and drive urgent management regardless.
